title: How a Robot Vacuum Works in 60 Seconds 🤖🧹 #shorts
description:
A robot vacuum maps your room with a spinning laser, sweeps dirt in with side brushes, and sucks it into a bin. Infrared cliff sensors underneath stop it falling down the stairs, and it drives home to charge on its own. Follow Inside 60 for a new "how it works" explained in 60 seconds.

#robotvacuum #smarthome #howitworks

steps.label: Hook
steps.text: A robot vacuum draws a *map* of your home with a spinning laser.

steps.label: Lidar
steps.text: The turret fires *laser* pulses and times how long they take to bounce back.

steps.label: Map
steps.text: Thousands of distances become a *map*, so it cleans in neat lines.

steps.label: Brushes
steps.text: Spinning *side brushes* flick dirt from corners toward the main brush.

steps.label: Suction
steps.text: A fan sucks the dirt up into the *dust bin*.

steps.label: Cliff sensors
steps.text: Infrared *cliff sensors* underneath spot the stairs, so it backs away. When the battery is low, it drives home to charge.

steps.label: Recap
steps.text: Scan, sweep, *suck*. Follow Inside 60 for more.
